attchmntText: Keynote Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Keynote Financial Services Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements for its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published in Business Standard, Free Press Journal, and Navshakti on November 14, 2026. The document also contains extracts of financial results for Centrum Capital Limited, Rap Corp Limited, Nirav Commercials Ltd, and TFCIL. Centrum Capital Limited reported a net profit of 355.42 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Rap Corp Limited reported a net profit of 45.48 lakhs for the same period. Nirav Commercials Ltd reported a net loss of 0.27 crores. TFCIL results are included in the filing.

attchmntText: Keynote Financial Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Keynote Financial Services Limited approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on a standalone and Consolidated basis. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and include a Limited Review Report from Statutory Auditor V K Beswal & Associates. The Board also approved a proposal to seek Members’ approval through Postal Ballot, including e-voting, for proposed material related party transactions to be entered into by the Company and its Subsidiaries. The Board Meeting commenced at 12:00 noon and concluded at 3:30 p.m. on November 13, 2026. The company is filing these results and the proposal for shareholder approval with the stock exchanges.
